title: 第十四章鬼手门南逃重建二第十五章初识锦衣卫一
content_zh:
洛千秋指尖敲击着桌案上的地形图，墨色的线条在烛光下勾勒出洛道山谷的轮廓，密密麻麻的红点标注着萧琰联军可能的进攻路线。“魔教的心思难测，”他抬头看向围坐的核心弟子，目光扫过每个人紧绷的脸庞，“他们若想借刀杀人，定会在萧琰全力攻山时突袭联军后路；可若想收编我们，又会假意助战，事后再将我们吞并。”
青竹堂新任堂主林墨握紧腰间的毒囊，指节泛白：“掌门，不如我们先下手为强？我带一队弟子潜入魔教营地，用‘醉魂散’搅乱他们的部署。”
“不可。”洛千秋摇头，指尖点在地形图上的鹰嘴崖，“此处是洛道咽喉，三面悬崖，只有一条栈道通行。萧琰若想攻山，必走此处。我们只需在栈道两侧布下‘落石阵’和‘毒雾网’，再派精锐弟子死守，便能拖延数日。”他顿了顿，目光转向负责联络的弟子沈青，“你再去一趟红衣教，告诉苏圣女，若魔教按兵不动，我们只需守住鹰嘴崖；若魔教异动，便请她率红衣教弟子从侧翼牵制，切记不可与魔教正面冲突。”
沈青领命离去时，夜色已深。洛千秋独自站在据点的瞭望塔上，寒风卷着枯草掠过脸颊，远处隐约传来狼嚎。他摸出怀中半块残缺的玉佩，那是二十年前救萧琰时，少年塞给他的信物，如今玉佩边缘已被岁月磨得光滑，却依旧能看清刻在上面的“萧”字。“你我之间，当真只剩血海深仇了吗？”他轻声呢喃，声音被风吹散在夜色中。
三日后，萧琰联军果然如期而至。三万余人的队伍沿着洛道蜿蜒而来，武当的太极旗、峨眉的莲花旗、昆仑的玄字旗在风中猎猎作响，阳光洒在刀剑上，折射出刺眼的寒光。萧琰身着银甲，手持“碎玉”剑走在最前方，玄真道长与峨眉静玄师太紧随其后，三人目光如炬，直盯着鹰嘴崖的方向。
“洛千秋，出来受死！”玄真道长的声音透过扩音功法传遍山谷，震得崖边的石块簌簌掉落。
瞭望塔上，洛千秋冷笑一声，挥手示意。早已埋伏在栈道两侧的弟子立刻转动机关，巨石从崖顶滚落，砸向联军队伍。同时，数十个装满毒雾的陶罐被推下，绿色的雾气瞬间弥漫在栈道上，联军弟子吸入毒雾后，纷纷倒地抽搐。
“卑鄙小人！竟敢用毒！”静玄师太怒喝一声，取出峨眉派的“清心散”分发给弟子，“大家屏住呼吸，随我冲！”
峨眉弟子手持长剑，踏着同伴的尸体强行冲锋，武当七子则结成剑阵，金色剑气劈开毒雾，为联军开辟出一条通路。洛千秋见状，亲自率精锐弟子冲下鹰嘴崖，玄铁拐杖横扫，将冲在最前面的几名武当弟子击飞。
“洛千秋！”萧琰眼中闪过一丝痛惜，手中“碎玉”剑直刺洛千秋心口，“你若束手就擒，我还能饶你弟子一命！”
“不必假惺惺！”洛千秋拐杖一挑，挡住剑身，“当年你在流沙中奄奄一息时，怎不说我鬼手门卑鄙？如今却跟着这些伪君子来杀我，你良心何在！”
两人兵器相交，火花四溅。萧琰的剑法轻盈灵动，如流水般连绵不绝；洛千秋的拐杖则刚猛霸道，每一击都带着千钧之力。激战中，洛千秋肩头被剑气划伤，鲜血浸透了玄色长袍，他却浑然不觉，拐杖挥舞得愈发迅猛。
就在此时，远处突然传来一阵马蹄声，黑色的旗帜在风中展开，上面绣着一个狰狞的骷髅头——是魔教的人马！
“哈哈哈！萧书生，你也有今日！”魔教教主夜惊风骑着黑马，手持鬼头刀，率五万魔教弟子杀来，“洛掌门，今日我便助你一臂之力，咱们联手，把这些名门正派都宰了！”
萧琰脸色骤变，他没想到魔教竟会突然介入，而且来势如此凶猛。“静玄师太，玄真道长，你们率军挡住魔教，我去对付洛千秋！”
然而，局势早已失控。魔教弟子如潮水般涌来，与联军厮杀在一起，洛道瞬间变成了人间炼狱。洛千秋趁机后退，率弟子撤回鹰嘴崖，却见沈青带着红衣教弟子赶来，苏红袖一身红衣在混乱中格外显眼。
“洛掌门，我们来了！”苏红袖手中红剑一挥，斩杀两名冲上来的魔教弟子，“夜惊风此人野心极大，不可轻信，我们需小心应对。”
洛千秋点头，目光扫过混战的战场，心中突然生出一个念头。他凑近苏红袖耳边，低声说了几句，苏红袖眼中闪过一丝惊讶，随即点头：“好，就按你说的办！”
洛千秋让人在鹰嘴崖上竖起白旗，示意停战。萧琰与夜惊风见状，都暂时下令收兵，战场瞬间安静下来，只剩下伤者的**和血腥味。
“洛千秋，你想耍什么花样？”萧琰勒住马，警惕地盯着崖上的洛千秋。

洛千秋站在崖边，声音传遍战场：“萧书生，夜教主，如今我们三方僵持，继续打下去只会两败俱伤。不如我们约定，三日后在洛道的望星台会面，当面解决恩怨，如何？”
夜惊风大笑一声：“好！我就喜欢你这爽快劲儿！三日后，我必到！”
萧琰犹豫片刻，他知道洛千秋不会轻易投降，但眼下魔教虎视眈眈，若能借会面的机会摸清洛千秋和夜惊风的底细，也未尝不可。“好，三日后，望星台见！”
约定达成后，三方各自撤兵。洛千秋回到据点，立刻召集核心弟子和苏红袖商议。“三日后的会面，必然是一场鸿门宴。萧琰想趁机除掉我们和夜惊风，夜惊风则想吞并我们和联军，我们必须做好万全准备。”
苏红袖取出一张望星台的地形图，铺在桌上：“望星台位于洛道中央，四周是开阔的平原，易攻难守。但台下有一条废弃的密道，是当年修建望星台时留下的，我们可以从密道部署伏兵。”
林墨眼睛一亮：“我带青竹堂弟子提前潜入密道，在里面布置‘化骨散’和‘霹雳弹’，只要他们进入密道，定让他们有来无回！”
沈青则说道：“我去联络附近的山贼，他们之前被我们打败过，如今对萧琰的联军也心怀不满，若能说服他们帮忙，我们的胜算会更大。”
洛千秋点头，目光坚定：“好！大家分头行动，务必在三日前做好准备。另外，我会亲自去见夜惊风，假意答应与他联手，让他放松警惕。”
次日，洛千秋只带了两名弟子，前往魔教营地。夜惊风见他单枪匹马前来，心中十分得意，以为洛千秋已经走投无路，只能投靠自己。“洛掌门，你能想通就好。只要你归顺我魔教，将来我统一江湖，定封你为副教主！”
洛千秋故作感激，双手抱拳：“多谢夜教主厚爱。只是萧琰联军实力雄厚，我们若想取胜，还需从长计议。三日后的会面，不如我们里应外合，先除掉萧琰，再慢慢收拾其他门派？”
夜惊风闻言，哈哈大笑：“好！就按你说的办！三日后，我会让弟子在望星台四周埋伏，只要你发出信号，我们就动手！”
洛千秋心中冷笑，表面却依旧恭敬：“多谢夜教主信任，洛某定不负所望。”
离开魔教营地后，洛千秋立刻赶往沈青联络的山贼据点。山贼首领黑虎是个身材魁梧的汉子，当年被洛千秋打败后，一直对鬼手门心怀敬畏。“洛掌门，你放心，萧琰那小子杀了我好几个兄弟，我早就想找他报仇了！三日后，我带五百弟兄，在望星台附近接应你！”
洛千秋拱手道谢，心中的计划逐渐成型。他知道，三日后的望星台，将是决定鬼手门命运的关键一战。
content_en:
Luo Qianqiu tapped the topographic map on the desk with his fingertips. The ink lines outlined the outline of the Luodao Valley in the candlelight, and dense red dots marked the possible attack route of Xiao Yan's coalition. "The devil's sect's thoughts are unpredictable," he looked up at the core disciples sitting around, his eyes sweeping across everyone's tense faces. "If they want to borrow a knife to kill someone, they will definitely attack the coalition's rear when Xiao Yan is attacking the mountain with all his strength; but if they want to recruit us, they will pretend to help, and then annex us afterwards."
Lin Mo, the new leader of Qingzhu Hall, clenched the poison sac around his waist, his knuckles turning white: "Master, why don't we strike first? I will lead a group of disciples to sneak into the demon sect's camp and use 'Drunken Soul Powder' to disrupt their plans."
"No." Luo Qianqiu shook his head and pointed his fingertips at the Eagle Beak Cliff on the topographic map. "This is the throat of Luo Dao, with cliffs on three sides and only one plank road leading to it. If Xiao Yan wants to attack the mountain, he must go here. We only need to set up a 'falling stone formation' and a 'poison mist net' on both sides of the plank road, and then send elite disciples to defend it. Delay for a few days." He paused and turned to the disciple in charge of contact, Shen Qing, "Go to the Red Clothes Sect again and tell Saint Su that if the Demon Sect does not move, we only need to hold the Eagle Beak Cliff; if the Demon Sect moves, ask her to lead the Red Clothes Sect disciples to contain it from the flanks, and remember not to conflict with the Demon Sect head-on. "
When Shen Qing took the order and left, the night was already dark. Luo Qianqiu stood alone on the watchtower of the stronghold, with the cold wind blowing the dead grass across his face, and the howling of wolves could be heard faintly in the distance. He took out a half-broken jade pendant in his arms, which was a token given to him by the young man when he rescued Xiao Yan twenty years ago. Now the edges of the jade pendant have been worn smooth by the years, but the word "Xiao" engraved on it can still be clearly seen. "Is there really only blood feud left between you and me?" He murmured softly, his voice being blown away by the wind in the night.
Three days later, Xiao Yan's coalition forces arrived as expected. A team of more than 30,000 people meandered along Luodao. The Tai Chi flag of Wudang, the lotus flag of Emei, and the Xuanzi flag of Kunlun were flapping in the wind. The sun shone on the swords, reflecting the dazzling cold light. Xiao Yan was wearing silver armor and walking at the front with a "Broken Jade" sword, followed closely by Taoist Priest Xuanzhen and Master Jingxuan of Emei. The three of them stared in the direction of Yingzui Cliff with their eyes like torches.
"Luo Qianqiu, come out and die!" Taoist Priest Xuanzhen's voice spread throughout the valley through the amplification technique, causing the rocks on the cliff to fall.
On the watchtower, Luo Qianqiu sneered and waved his hand. The disciples who had been ambushing on both sides of the plank road immediately turned their mechanisms, and the boulders rolled down from the top of the cliff, hitting the coalition troops. At the same time, dozens of clay pots filled with poisonous mist were pushed down, and green mist instantly filled the plank road. After inhaling the poisonous mist, the coalition disciples fell to the ground and twitched one after another.
"Despicable villain! How dare you use poison!" Master Jingxuan shouted angrily, took out the Emei Sect's "Qingxin Powder" and distributed it to the disciples, "Everyone, hold your breath and follow me!"
The Emei disciples held long swords and charged forcefully over the corpses of their companions. The Seven Wudang disciples formed a sword formation. The golden sword energy split the poisonous mist and opened a path for the coalition forces. Seeing this, Luo Qianqiu personally led his elite disciples to rush down the Eagle Beak Cliff. His black iron crutch swept across and knocked away the few Wudang disciples who were rushing at the front.
"Luo Qianqiu!" A trace of regret flashed in Xiao Yan's eyes, and the "Broken Jade" sword in his hand pierced Luo Qianqiu's heart, "If you just surrender, I can still spare your disciple's life!"
"No need to be hypocritical!" Luo Qianqiu raised his crutch to block the blade of the sword. "When you were dying in the quicksand, why didn't you say that I was despicable? Now you follow these hypocrites to kill me. Where is your conscience!"
The two weapons clashed, sparks flying. Xiao Yan's swordsmanship was light and agile, as continuous as flowing water; Luo Qianqiu's crutch was fierce and domineering, with every blow carrying a huge amount of power. During the fierce battle, Luo Qianqiu's shoulder was scratched by the sword energy, and his black robe was soaked with blood. However, he was completely unaware and swung his cane faster and faster.
At this moment, the sound of horse hooves suddenly came from the distance.The colorful flag unfolded in the wind, with a ferocious skull embroidered on it - it was the troops of the Demon Sect!
"Hahaha! Xiao Shusheng, you also have this day!" The leader of the Demon Cult, Ye Jingfeng, rode on a black horse and held a ghost-headed sword, leading 50,000 Demon Cult disciples to kill him. "Master Luo, I will help you today. Let's join hands and kill all these famous sects!"
Xiao Yan's expression suddenly changed. He did not expect that the Demon Cult would suddenly intervene and come with such ferocity. "Master Jingxuan, Taoist Priest Xuanzhen, you lead the army to stop the Demon Cult, and I will deal with Luo Qianqiu!"
However, the situation has already gotten out of control. The demon sect disciples came in like a tide and fought with the coalition forces. Luodao instantly turned into a purgatory on earth. Luo Qianqiu took the opportunity to retreat and led his disciples back to Yingzui Cliff, only to see Shen Qing coming with the red-clothed disciples. Su Hongxiu, dressed in red, stood out in the chaos.
"Master Luo, we are here!" Su Hongxiu swung the red sword in her hand and killed two demon sect disciples who rushed up. "Ye Jingfeng is extremely ambitious and cannot be trusted. We need to be careful when dealing with him."
Luo Qianqiu nodded, looking across the melee battlefield, and an idea suddenly came to his mind. He leaned close to Su Hongxiu's ear and whispered a few words. A trace of surprise flashed in Su Hongxiu's eyes, and then she nodded: "Okay, I'll do as you say!"
Luo Qianqiu had people put up a white flag on Yingzui Cliff to signal a truce. Upon seeing this, Xiao Yan and Ye Jingfeng temporarily ordered their troops to retreat. The battlefield instantly became quiet, leaving only the smell of the wounded's flesh and blood.
"Luo Qianqiu, what tricks do you want to play?" Xiao Yan reined in his horse and stared at Luo Qianqiu on the cliff warily.
Luo Qianqiu stood on the edge of the cliff, and his voice spread throughout the battlefield: "Scholar Xiao, Master Ye, we are now in a stalemate among the three parties. If we continue to fight, we will only lose both sides. How about we agree to meet at the Stargazing Tower in Luodao in three days to resolve our grudges face to face?"
Ye Jingfeng laughed loudly: "Okay! I like your refreshing energy! I will be there in three days!"
Xiao Yan hesitated for a moment. He knew that Luo Qianqiu would not surrender easily, but the Demon Cult was currently eyeing them. If they could take the opportunity of the meeting to find out the details about Luo Qianqiu and Ye Jingfeng, it would be a good idea. "Okay, see you at the Stargazing Tower in three days!"
After the agreement was reached, the three parties each withdrew their troops. Luo Qianqiu returned to his stronghold and immediately summoned his core disciples to discuss with Su Hongxiu. "The meeting in three days will definitely be a Hongmen Banquet. Xiao Yan wants to take the opportunity to get rid of us and Ye Jingfeng, while Ye Jingfeng wants to annex us and the coalition forces. We must be fully prepared."
Su Hongxiu took out a topographic map of the Star Observation Tower and spread it on the table: "The Star Observation Tower is located in the center of Luodao, surrounded by open plains. It is easy to attack and difficult to defend. However, there is an abandoned secret passage under the stage, which was left behind when the Star Observation Tower was built. We can deploy ambush through the secret passage."
Lin Mo's eyes lit up: "I took the disciples of Qingzhu Hall to sneak into the secret passage in advance and placed the 'Huagu Powder' and 'Thunderbolt Bullets' inside. As long as they enter the secret passage, they will never come back!"
Shen Qingze said: "I will contact the nearby bandits. They have been defeated by us before, and now they are also dissatisfied with Xiao Yan's coalition. If we can persuade them to help, our chances of winning will be greater."
Luo Qianqiu nodded with a firm look: "Okay! Everyone split up and make preparations three days in advance. In addition, I will go to see Ye Jingfeng in person and pretend to agree to join forces with him to make him relax his vigilance."
The next day, Luo Qianqiu took only two disciples to the Demon Cult camp. Ye Jingfeng felt very proud when he saw him coming alone, thinking that Luo Qianqiu had no choice but to rely on him. "Master Luo, I wish you could figure it out. As long as you submit to our demon sect, I will unify the world and make you the deputy leader in the future!"
Luo Qianqiu pretended to be grateful and clasped his fists: "Thank you very much, Lord Ye, for your love. However, Xiao Yan's alliance is strong. If we want to win, we need to take a long-term approach. For the meeting in three days, it is better for us to cooperate internally and externally, get rid of Xiao Yan first, and then slowly clean up the other sects.group? "
Ye Jingfeng heard this and laughed loudly: "Okay! Just do as you say! Three days later, I will ask my disciples to ambush around the Star Watching Tower. As long as you send a signal, we will take action! "
Luo Qianqiu sneered in his heart, but remained respectful on the outside: "Thank you to Master Ye for trusting me, Luo will definitely live up to your expectations. "
After leaving the Demon Cult camp, Luo Qianqiu immediately rushed to the bandit stronghold contacted by Shen Qing. The bandit leader Hei Hu is a burly man. After being defeated by Luo Qianqiu, he has always been in awe of the Ghost Hand Sect. "Master Luo, don't worry, that boy Xiao Yan killed several of my brothers, and I have long wanted to take revenge on him! Three days later, I will take five hundred brothers to meet you near the Star Watching Tower! "
Luo Qianqiu cupped his hands and thanked him, and the plan in his mind gradually took shape. He knew that the Star Watching Tower three days later would be a crucial battle that decided the fate of the Ghost Hand Sect.
